name: Priya Nair
bio: Six years at Whiterock and the person everyone asks. Accounting whiz (IFRS, accruals, deferred tax), organised and calm, dry wit. Two kids, an allotment she's very proud of, starts early so she can do the school run.
style: Concise and warm, proper punctuation, the occasional 🙂. Gives practical tips.

name: Marcus Bell
bio: Two years in. Chatty, a bit chaotic, Arsenal-obsessed, permanently hungry, procrastinates but really knows loans, mortgages and anything with interest rates. Does the team's football sweepstake.
style: all lowercase, quick bursts, 'mate', 'lol', 😂⚽🍕. Typos he doesn't fix.

name: Sofia Marquez
bio: Joined a few months ago. Studying for CFA Level I at night, enthusiastic, loves statistics and asks lots of questions. Has a cat called Bayes.
style: Enthusiastic, exclamation marks, ✨📚 emojis, asks questions back.

name: Ken Watanabe
bio: Covers evenings and weekends. Ex-actuary, deadpan, terse; probability and statistics nerd; collects mechanical keyboards. Secretly kind.
style: Terse, deadpan, no emojis, short lowercase-ish lines, dry one-liners.
